labels.notes: Salesforce provides free self-serve Developer Edition orgs with full REST and SOAP API access and an official hosted MCP server. | Developer Edition includes 15,000 daily API calls with full access to standard and custom objects.

Copper provides a public REST API with API keys and OAuth2, accessible immediately via a self-serve 14-day free business trial. | Admins generate API keys in Settings. Free trial includes Business tier features.

Front provides a public REST API and free developer accounts with Bearer API tokens, OAuth 2.0, and an official MCP server. | Front offers free developer accounts on dev.frontapp.com supporting up to 3 teammates.

Help Scout provides a public REST API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and an official MCP server, accessible via a self-serve 15-day free trial. | The permanent free plan does not include API access, but the 15-day self-serve trial does.
Pumble provides a public REST API with self-serve API keys on its free plan and an official MCP server. | API addon is free to install on all workspaces and generates standard API keys.

Discord provides an open, self-serve public REST API using bot tokens and OAuth 2.0 with many community MCP servers. | Bot tokens function as static dashboard API keys; gateway websocket API also available.

Klaviyo provides a public REST API accessible on its self-serve free plan with API keys and OAuth, plus an official remote MCP server. | Remote MCP server available at mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp with role-based scoping.
SendGrid provides a public REST API authenticated via API keys with a 60-day self-serve trial. | API keys are passed via Bearer header or HTTP Basic Auth.

Shopify provides free self-serve development stores via Partner accounts with comprehensive GraphQL and REST Admin APIs and official MCP servers. | Official dev-mcp exists in @shopify/dev-mcp alongside built-in Storefront MCP endpoints on all stores.

Adobe Commerce requires an enterprise sales engagement or partner license to access cloud developer environments and credentials. | While open source Magento can be self-hosted, Adobe Commerce cloud licenses require sales contact.
Firecrawl provides a public REST API with a self-serve free tier using API keys, as well as an official MCP server. | Supports keyless usage and OAuth MCP alongside standard API key authentication.

Waterfall.io provides a REST API using API keys, but access is gated behind custom quoting and booking a sales call. | No self-serve signup or free tier; onboarding requires booking a demo call and custom pricing.

MongoDB Atlas provides a public REST Administration API with self-serve free tier access and official MCP servers. | Free M0 cluster available without credit card; supports Service Accounts (OAuth2) and legacy Digest API keys.

Datadog provides an extensive public REST API using API/application keys, a 14-day self-serve free trial, and an official MCP server. | Requires DD-API-KEY and DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers. Official MCP server maintained under datadog-labs.

Airtable provides a public REST API with self-serve personal access tokens and OAuth 2.0 on its free plan, along with an official MCP server. | Legacy API keys were deprecated in favor of Personal Access Tokens (Bearer PATs) and OAuth 2.0.

Monday.com provides a public GraphQL API accessible via a free self-serve developer account using API tokens or OAuth 2.0, along with an official MCP server. | Monday.com API is entirely GraphQL-based; free developer account does not expire.

Stripe provides a public REST API with instant self-serve test-mode API keys on free accounts and an official MCP server. | Test mode keys are generated immediately upon signing up for a free account.

iPayX Protocol provides a narrow REST API and official MCP server for FX audits, requiring a paid API plan ($99/mo). | Official MCP server available at mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp. Narrow surface of ~5 endpoints for FX forensics.

NotebookLM (Gemini Notebook Enterprise) provides REST APIs via Google Cloud Discovery Engine authenticated by OAuth 2.0 / bearer tokens, but requires a paid enterprise subscription. | Consumer NotebookLM lacks an official API; enterprise features are exposed via Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Discovery Engine APIs.

TranscriptAPI provides a public REST API and official MCP server for YouTube transcripts with 100 free credits upon self-serve registration. | Single-purpose API offering transcripts, metadata, search, and native MCP at transcriptapi.com/mcp.
